# Keymaps

The TUI has two keymaps, chosen with `tui.keymap` in the [config file](/docs/configuration/) or the `:keymap` command: `default` (arrows and PgUp/PgDn) and `vim` (the same keys plus hjkl and friends). Press `F1` or `?` in the TUI to see the keys for the current context. For the rest of the TUI, see the [TUI guide](/docs/tui/).

## Navigation

| Action | Default | Vim |
| --- | --- | --- |
| move up | `up` | `up` `k` |
| move down | `down` | `down` `j` |
| move left | `left` | `left` `h` |
| move right | `right` | `right` `l` |
| page up | `pgup` | `pgup` `ctrl+u` |
| page down | `pgdown` | `pgdown` `ctrl+d` |
| go to top | `ctrl+home` | `ctrl+home` `gg` |
| go to bottom | `ctrl+end` | `ctrl+end` `G` |
| first column | `home` | `home` |
| last column | `end` | `end` |

## Panes

| Action | Default | Vim |
| --- | --- | --- |
| next pane | `tab` | `tab` |
| previous pane | `shift+tab` | `shift+tab` |
| open / row detail | `enter` | `enter` |
| back / close | `esc` | `esc` |
| filter rows | `f` | `f` |
| filter sidebar | `/` | `/` |
| cycle sort | `s` | `s` |

## Grid

| Action | Default | Vim |
| --- | --- | --- |
| widen column | `>` | `>` |
| narrow column | `<` | `<` |
| copy cell | `y` | `y` |
| copy row as JSON | `Y` | `Y` |
| edit cell | `e` | `e` |
| insert a row | `i` | `i` |
| mark / unmark the row for deletion | `d` | `d` |
| set the edited cell to NULL | `ctrl+n` | `ctrl+n` |
| save a multi-line cell edit | `ctrl+s` | `ctrl+s` |
| find rows similar to this one (vector collections) | `S` | `S` |
| row detail: collapse every node | `[` | `[` |
| row detail: expand every node | `]` | `]` |
| live tail the open collection (drivers with watch support) | `W` | `W` |
| live tail: pause / resume | `p` | `p` |
| live tail: clear the events | `c` | `c` |

## App

| Action | Default | Vim |
| --- | --- | --- |
| command palette | `:` | `:` |
| help | `f1` `?` | `f1` `?` |
| quit | `q` | `q` |
| cancel a run, :apply, export or load (waits on a commit or rollback) / quit | `ctrl+c` | `ctrl+c` |
| open the AI panel / close it | `a` | `a` |
| fix a failed run with AI (on its error tab) | `f` | `f` |
| AI panel: load the proposed query into the editor (ctrl+enter / f5 also runs it) | `ctrl+o` | `ctrl+o` |
| AI panel: copy the proposed query | `ctrl+y` | `ctrl+y` |
| add connection | `n` | `n` |
| edit connection | `E` | `E` |
| delete connection | `D` | `D` |

## Editor

| Action | Default | Vim |
| --- | --- | --- |
| open / close the query editor | `ctrl+e` | `ctrl+e` |
| run the statement or selection | `ctrl+enter` `f5` | `ctrl+enter` `f5` |
| run the whole buffer | `alt+enter` `shift+f5` | `alt+enter` `shift+f5` |
| previous result tab | `[` | `[` |
| next result tab | `]` | `]` |
| close result tab | `x` | `x` |
| complete the name at the cursor | `ctrl+space` | `ctrl+space` |
| search the query history | `ctrl+r` | `ctrl+r` |
